vinculin participates selectively in a contractile mechanism of endothelial permeability by integrating focal adhesions with stress fibers, which leads to maximal Rho activation and endothelial permeability response.

the mechanisms by which vascular endothelial permeability is regulated by the extracellular environment and the intracellular cytoskeleton.
the molecular mechanisms of endothelial barrier dysfunction, which is a hallmark of many diseases, including sepsis and acute lung injury.
the role of the adaptor molecule vinculin in the mechanisms of vascular endothelium permeability and barrier dysfunction.

vinculin is a key regulator of endothelial barrier dysfunction induced by contractile mechanisms but not by noncontractile mechanisms.
